title: Browser Task Envelope
description: Structured task instruction for the desktop_runner to execute via Anthropic Computer Use API. Generated by Claude CLI, consumed by desktop_runner.py.

task_id.description: Unique task ID, prefix btsk_ for Browser TaSK

correlation_id.description: Parent event/session ID; falls back to task_id if root-level

natural_language_goal.description: What the agent should accomplish. Plain English. Include exact URL, button labels, field values, and the result to capture.

expected_result_schema.description: Optional shape hint for the captured result (e.g., {"api_key": "string"}). Runner does NOT enforce -- this is a hint for downstream parsers.

screenshots_dir.description: Relative path under /AA_MY_DRIVE/_logs/browser_tasks/screenshots/ for per-action PNGs

result.description: Filled in by runner: captured outputs (api_key, page_title, etc), final_screenshot, actual_iterations, error if any

context.description: Rich project context the desktop agent receives in addition to the bare goal.

conversation_summary.description: 200-500 word summary of why this task matters

excerpt.description: first 30 lines of the file (or selector match), embedded so the agent doesn't need filesystem access mid-task

previous_state.description: Auto-captured: halt_check output, last 5 commits, last 3 audit envelopes

success_criteria.description: What the agent must verify before declaring done

do_not.description: Hard-stop predicates the agent must avoid
